summary: Kitchen Armor, headquartered in Irvine, CA, has operated since 1991 as a kitchen-centric hardware and consulting provider, engineering ruggedized PoE-powered stainless-steel kitchen display systems designed to withstand heat, grease, and moisture in commercial kitchens.

Kitchen Armor partnered with QSR Automations (Crunchtime) to co-offer Android-based all-in-one PoE touchscreen devices alongside its existing Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC hardware line, expanding hardware/software bundling options for kitchen display deployments. (Scope note: Exact announcement date not confirmed; page now redirects into Crunchtime's blog after a QSR Automations/Crunchtime rebrand.)

Kitchen Armor named Flanigan's, a well-known Florida restaurant chain, as a customer partnership aimed at improving overall kitchen operations. (Scope note: Single named account; no operator-reported ROI figures disclosed.)
